functionDeclarations.name: search_catalog
functionDeclarations.description: Search verified collectible categories, franchises, sets, products, and checklist items. Returns source and freshness metadata.

functionDeclarations.name: search_events
functionDeclarations.description: Search verified card shows and collectible events with venues, dates, organizers, ticket offers, and last verification time.

functionDeclarations.name: get_vendor_profile
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve a vendor business profile, verified public contact methods, show appearances, reputation snapshot, evidence confidence, and disclosure.

functionDeclarations.name: create_card_show_capture
functionDeclarations.description: Create a private wishlist capture tied to the authenticated collector, show session, vendor, booth, private image object, asking price, and recognition candidates. Never publishes inventory.

functionDeclarations.name: run_collection_recommendation
functionDeclarations.description: Calculate explainable collection-completion recommendations using owned quantities, missing checklist items, budget, maximum prices, source freshness, and confidence.

functionDeclarations.name: run_deck_recommendation
functionDeclarations.description: Calculate owned-versus-required deck recommendations with core cards, flex cards, substitutes, legality, rotation, budget, and source timestamps.

functionDeclarations.name: run_bargain_grading_analysis
functionDeclarations.description: Evaluate a low-cost card as a raw hold, raw sale, grading candidate, manual review, or pass using purchase price, condition confidence, grading service data, fees, grade probabilities, and liquidity.

functionDeclarations.name: create_savings_goal
functionDeclarations.description: Create a private manual savings goal for an event, ticket, travel, release, grading submission, collection goal, or deck goal. Does not move money.

functionDeclarations.name: prepare_quickbooks_invoice
functionDeclarations.description: Prepare an authorized, idempotent QuickBooks invoice request for a confirmed ACool order. The server must verify organization, amount, currency, accounting mapping, and connection before execution.

functionDeclarations.name: resolve_affiliate_link
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve an approved active affiliate link and return destination plus required disclosure. Does not approve programs or fabricate an affiliation.

functionDeclarations.name: build_public_metadata
functionDeclarations.description: Build schema.org JSON-LD, canonical, Open Graph, and social metadata for an approved public page. Must withhold offers, ratings, and affiliations when evidence is insufficient.

functionDeclarations.name: request_human_approval
functionDeclarations.description: Create a human approval request for publication, price override, payout, refund, custody movement, promotion drawing, affiliation claim, accounting adjustment, or production release.
